semantic-fidelity.demonstrated: Bounded two-domain fidelity through actual Ingest, Elaborate and full pipeline for all three real frontends; common module policy and stable-label edits; safe-integer range; structured frontend retained.
semantic-fidelity.scope: Experimental declaration grammar and accepted Phase 4 bounds; no final DSL selection.

stage-isolation.scope: Bounded Phase 5 experiment contracts; production candidate eligibility excludes rejected Xtext. This is not complete production compiler/target implementation.
stage-isolation.demonstrated: True persistent ANTLR/Langium/Xtext native runtimes, PID/sequence checks, active cancellation, real crash/restart/queued retry, native malformed/oversize/stale transport faults, complete host pipelines and independently implemented core fault slices. Direct JVM/Node calls and real frontend-to-core serialization are measured. Approval authority remains outside workers.

diagnostic-correctness.scope: Bounded Phase 5 experiment contracts; production candidate eligibility excludes rejected Xtext. This is not complete production compiler/target implementation.
diagnostic-correctness.demonstrated: Actual immutable compiler Failure transports exact recoverable syntax/reference/module/policy tokens, subject/related IDs, related locations, stable codes and fixed safe remediation. EOF is a real parser token; genuinely unrecoverable locations are explicitly classified. All three frontends share deterministic projections.

determinism.scope: Bounded Phase 5 experiment contracts; production candidate eligibility excludes rejected Xtext. This is not complete production compiler/target implementation.
determinism.demonstrated: Bounded concurrent independent native parser and complete compiler requests for every frontend; same/different domains, warm requests, queued restart, real cancellation races/crash/retry, environment/cwd/tmp/locale/seed permutations. Ordered semantic changes alter canonical digests and later original input restores the original digest.

source-intelligence-viability.demonstrated: Native TypeScript and javac semantic bindings demonstrate imports, TS aliases, overloads, interfaces/inheritance, generated/human ownership markers, rename continuity and unresolved calls. Syntax-only stays UNKNOWN. Unprovenanced prebuilt wasm explicitly rejected for production.
source-intelligence-viability.scope: Bounded feasibility fixtures, not complete production target adapters.

evolution-maintenance-viability.scope: Bounded Phase 5 experiment contracts; production candidate eligibility excludes rejected Xtext. This is not complete production compiler/target implementation.
evolution-maintenance-viability.demonstrated: Surviving ANTLR and Langium use the approved controlled grammar upgrades and isolated locks. Java/Node/Rust toolchain fault/canonical corpora pass controlled comparisons with unchanged pins and rollback. All 21 locked Rust crate license records restored. Exact ANTLR3 source notice and upstream AOP Alliance declaration resolve the absent POM metadata. Xtext is formally rejected on critical patched generator source/build provenance; it cannot satisfy this gate.

unrunScaleExperiments: Full 10k/100k ACP semantic validation is NOT_SUPPORTED under unchanged 2000-node/1MiB bounds.
Incremental ACP semantic validation is NOT_SUPPORTED; bounded full revalidation is measured. Native document-builder/resource updates are separate.
coreLimitations: Java/TypeScript/Rust remain viable on identical representative happy/fault slices, not complete candidate implementations of all eight Phase 4 stages.
Same-process comparisons call real native parsers inside JVM/Node. Python cannot directly embed these engines; no synthetic embedding is scored.
A full production deployment still needs a selected frontend/core implementation and its release packaging. Architecture acceptance does not claim those ports exist.
rule: Only PASS satisfies required hard gates. Xtext is excluded by a material provenance failure. Missing soft data forbids an aggregate weighted score. Four independent decisions may accept architectures while deferring runtime/framework commitment; Phase 6 requires separate authorization.

xtext.reason: Exact patched ANTLR3 generator SHA256 is pinned, but its source revision, patch set and reproducible build are not verified.
xtext.otherEvidence: Persistent worker, diagnostic and concurrency tests retained; speed did not cause rejection.

softScoringDisposition.reason: Comparable production editor and team ergonomics measurements remain incomplete. Missing values are not zeroes or favorable scores. Raw performance/memory/serialization data is retained; no runtime/frontend winner is inferred from speed. All hard gates pass for surviving frontends at declared experimental scope; independent final runtime/frontend decisions intentionally remain DEFERRED.
